title: Show the Here entry for the device time
body:
The OpenSpec change `show-here-entry-for-device-time` is already prepared in `openspec/changes/show-here-entry-for-device-time/`. Do not create a new change.

**specify:** run the `openspec-propose` procedure against this existing change. It was written before its dependencies were implemented: re-check every claim about the code against the current `main`, in particular the real owner names that `set-home-location-and-show-differences` introduced (`getOffsetDifferenceMinutes`, `formatOffsetDifference`, `LocationMenu`, `offsetDifferenceLabel`), and update the artifacts. Keep the scope and decisions. Leave it the only active change.

Depends on: `support-legacy-ios-12-safari`, `set-home-location-and-show-differences` (both archived).

Goal (ADR-0007): the device time is always on screen. When no location matches the device time zone, a derived Here entry is shown first.

Decided:
- The Here entry shows the here icon, the exemplar city, the caption «здесь», the meta line «Время устройства · UTC+5», local time and date, a day track and the offset difference from home (none when there is no home).
- It is not stored, cannot be removed, reordered or made home, has no drag handle and no menu, and is rendered outside the numbered list and outside the reorder context.
- Visibility uses the same rule as the Here mark (`isLocationInDeviceTimeZone`).
- Time, date, offset and day track come from one zone-level owner shared with `presentLocationRows`, not from a copy.
- City name: `CitySearch.getExemplarCity`, loaded in the background. Until it loads, or if loading fails, the name derived from the zone ID is shown. The derive function is shared with the zone cities source.
- Empty state: the Here entry, then «Места пока не добавлены», then «Добавить место». No Here entry on the unreadable-list error screen.
- On outdated zone data (iOS 12) the device zone works through the legacy zone shim.
- No "Add to list" action in the Here entry.
